actions.action: Cease and desist order and civil money penalty ($350M)
actions.summary: BSA program deficiencies: weak risk assessment of the card business, ineffective customer due diligence and risk rating, untimely or missed SARs. OCC tied the gaps to roughly $13B in suspected trade-based money laundering. A parallel Federal Reserve order adds transaction monitoring, fraud-referral, third-party risk and OFAC remediation. Best used as a peer story for mid-size card issuers.
